lede: The biggest thing to watch this week is the Telluride Medical Center's special board meeting Monday on whether to engage Jensen Partners for due diligence with CommonSpirit Health — one of the country's largest hospital systems — a signal that a major affiliation or transaction may be in motion. Also on the agenda side, Ouray City Council holds a public hearing on its 2027 budget and votes on utility rate ordinances, and Telluride's Ecology Commission takes up a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered lawn equipment in town limits by 2028–2030. On the lighter side, Mountainfilm for Locals runs Monday and Tuesday, and the Warren Miller film lands Wednesday at the Sherbino.

notable.stake: Board votes on engaging due diligence partner for potential CommonSpirit Health affiliation.
Public hearing on Ouray's 2027 budget; council votes on new utility and industrial rate ordinances.
Draft ordinance would ban gas-powered lawn equipment in Telluride by 2028–2030.
P&Z Chair decides lot merger in Historic Residential zone at W Columbia and N Townsend.
